verification.notes: Public MIT source and the Windows package manifest were checked at this revision; x64 and ARM64 are supported. The app requires a user-supplied Google Places API key and optionally an Azure Maps key for its live data features. The app icon was downloaded from Assets/Square150x150Logo.png, parsed as a raster PNG, and checked against the MIT-covered source assets. No screenshot or install/remix claim is included.
